entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 786420645182229504: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 57399: distance 56.306 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.009), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 56.306 +/- 0.507 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 16.4382 +/- 0.1130 mas (same row, RUWE 2.15), 145.5 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -138.297, 28.660 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 786420645182229504 (quality A), from 2008AJ....135..209M; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 19.432 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 57399: radius 19.432 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 136.908 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.057) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4482 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 57399: effective temperature 4482 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.06).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 605: HR 4518; VizieR III/202, cross-checked against Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 786420645182229504 (30 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffddaf. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 102224 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 4518 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 4518 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 4518 is not in part2; kharitonov: used.
